description: Gate delay line with eight taps spaced evenly along it, giving up to 40 seconds of delay

params.text: Sets the delay reached at the last tap, between zero and the number of seconds chosen on RANGE
Attenuverts the time CV before it is added to the DELAY knob
Sets the longest delay the line reaches, at 10 seconds, 20 seconds or 40 seconds
Switches the undelayed gate into the MIXED output
Switches that tap into the MIXED output

inputs.text: Voltage control over the delay time, attenuverted and added to the DELAY knob

outputs.text: The incoming gate passed straight through, undelayed
The incoming gate delayed by that tap's share of the time, the eight taps dividing the delay into equal steps with the last at the full time
Goes high whenever any of the gates switched in by the MIX buttons is high

notes: moving RANGE from a shorter setting to a longer one can put a gate out a second time, because gates already in the delay line are read again at the new spacing
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
